title: Journal appends only for roles whose action-scope holds them
situation: In the execution cut's live evaluation of example 15 (2026-10-10), the composed lead, meeting a meaning question, asked the architect as required, and also recorded its recommendation in the concept journal as an open decision, in 5 of 5 runs. The journal is the architect's record; the lead's action-scope does not include appending to it, but under 0051 action-scope states purpose and is not yet enforced. This is the observed use 0051 says reach narrows from.
decision: The cratylus extension offers the concept journal's appending verbs only to an agent whose action-scope includes append-journal; every other agent gets its read verbs, as the assayer already does. The lead brings meaning questions through the reporting line, not the journal.
consequences: Realized in the cut that follows the execution cut, extending the read-only gate the catalog re-cut built for the assayer; the lead's open-decision entries from the live runs stay where they were recorded (test fixtures), nothing in the real journal.
